programme.title: Million Dollar Baby - Sonhos Vencidos
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn sempre treinou boxeurs e a mais importante de todas as lições que lhes ensina é aquela que aplica na sua vida: protege-te a ti mesmo! Mas quando Maggie lhe surge no ginásio a pedir que ele a treine, ele está longe de adivinhar o desafio que ambos terão de enfrentar…

programme.title: Os Segredos Que Ocultamos
programme.desc: Nos EUA, após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, uma refugiada romena reconstrói a vida com o marido americano mas ainda continua atormentada pela memória dos horrores do conflito, acabando por raptar um vizinho em busca de vingança pelos crimes de guerra hediondos que ela acredita que ele cometeu.

programme.title: Repo Men: Os Cobradores
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, é possível comprar órgãos artificiais a crédito, mas quem não os paga recebe a visita de uma equipa de cobradores que não tem pruridos em arrancá-los dos novos corpos. Só que um deles vê-se com um coração artificial e vai ter de lutar para se manter vivo.

programme.title: Flag Day: Dias Perdidos
programme.desc: Jennifer Vogel tenta superar os destroços do passado ao mesmo tempo que concilia o laço inescapável com o seu pai, que vive uma vida dupla de falsificador, assaltante de bancos e vigarista para a conseguir sustentar.

programme.title: Abbé Pierre Uma Vida De Causas
programme.desc: A vida de Henri Grouès, conhecido por Abade Pierre, desde os seus tempos na Resistência durante a II Guerra Mundial até às suas batalhas contra a pobreza e pela defesa dos sem-abrigo.

programme.title: Medida Provisória
programme.desc: Num futuro distópico, o governo brasileiro decreta uma medida provisória que obriga os cidadãos negros a “regressarem” a África, como forma de reparar os erros cometidos na era da escravatura, o que provoca o caos, protestos e um movimento de resistência que vai inspirar a nação.

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: De criança que cantava no coro da igreja onde o pai era pastor até ao reconhecimento internacional, “Respect” acompanha a notável história de vida da cantora e compositora norte-americana Aretha Franklin e a jornada que efetuou para encontrar sua voz.

programme.title: Sem Tempo A Perder
programme.desc: Em Lyon, em 1942, um pequeno grupo resistentes franceses usa a rádio para transmitir mensagens de esperança aos outros sobreviventes, tentando não ser descobertos pela Gestapo.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Assalto Ao Shopping
programme.desc: Eddie Deacon é um ex-militar que só consegue arranjar emprego como segurança de supermercado. Logo na primeira noite, tem de proteger uma menina que é atacada por mercenários profissionais para a impedirem de testemunhar contra eles.

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: Hércules Contra Sansão
programme.desc: Partindo de Ítaca, Hércules e Ulisses lançam-se ao mar para caçar o monstro marinho que está a matar os pescadores locais. Quando o barco naufraga, os aventureiros vão parar à Terra Santa, onde o semi-deus é confundido com Sansão, que é um homem procurado, e com o qual acabará por juntar forças.

programme.title: Repo Men: Os Cobradores
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, é possível comprar órgãos artificiais a crédito, mas quem não os paga recebe a visita de uma equipa de cobradores que não tem pruridos em arrancá-los dos novos corpos. Só que um deles vê-se com um coração artificial e vai ter de lutar para se manter vivo.

programme.title: Há Dias De Azar…
programme.desc: Um erro de identificação coloca Slevin no meio de uma guerra travada pelos dois líderes da máfia nova-iorquina. Perseguido por um assassino profissional e sob intensa vigilância do detetive Brikowski, ele terá que encontrar uma forma de escapar com vida da confusão em que entrou...

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Os irmãos JP e Mikey tiveram uma infância complicada. Atualmente, o primeiro é dono de uma empresa de construção mas o segundo é um pequeno mafioso, que é raptado pelo criminoso Eddie King. JP vai arriscar tudo para resgatar o irmão, que sempre fez tudo por ele.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: A Balada De Adam Henry
programme.desc: Fiona Maye é uma juíza que tem de julgar o caso de um adolescente de 17 anos com leucemia que é Testemunha de Jeová e se recusa, por motivos religiosos, a receber uma transfusão de sangue que o poderá ajudar a salvar a vida.

programme.title: Todos Sabem
programme.desc: Laura viaja com os filhos de Buenos Aires até à sua aldeia-natal perto de Madrid para assistir ao casamento da irmã, mas uma série de acontecimentos desencadeia uma crise familiar que vai expor segredos do passado.

programme.title: Mascarade
programme.desc: Quando um jovem gigolo se apaixona por uma irresistível vigarista, um esquema desonesto é concebido à luz do sol escaldante da Côte d´Azur. Na busca de uma vida de luxo, irão os dois amantes tão longe a ponto de sacrificar o sustento de um agente imobiliário e de uma estrela de cinema reformada?

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Invisível Nas Cores
programme.desc: Quando os poderes de Ruth são descobertos, ela é forçada a abandonar a sua família. Anos depois, a sua missão de permanecer invisível leva-a de volta a casa, o único sítio onde estará segura, junto da sua mãe e da sua filha, também elas com super-poderes.

programme.title: Sempre A Abrir
programme.desc: Para ajudar a namorada a ir a uma entrevista de emprego em Los Angeles, o ex-motorista de fugas Charlie Bronson quebra a regra de isolamento a que está imposto pelo Plano de Proteção de Testemunhas mas é implacavelmente perseguido estrada fora pelo FBI e pelo seu ex-gangue.

programme.title: Impacto Mortífero
programme.desc: Steve Wakes é um detetive da polícia determinado a encontrar o assassino que lhe matou o parceiro, num tiroteio que atingiu Madison, uma testemunha essencial no processo. Só que o seu grande receio confirma-se: os assassinos são dois polícias corruptos dispostos a tudo para encobrir o crime…

programme.title: Dog: A Aventura De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Briggs, um ex-ranger do exército, é encarregue de conduzir Lulu, um pastor belga militar de comportamento agressivo, pela costa do Pacífico até ao funeral do seu dono, numa jornada em que ambos terão de lidar com os traumas do seu passado e encontrar um ponto de equilíbrio.

programme.title: A Modista
programme.desc: Quando Tilly regressa a casa, numa pequena cidade rural australiana, vai reconciliar-se com a mãe doente e vai recorrer à sua experiência na alta costura para transformar as mulheres locais e vingar-se de quem antes lhe tinha feito mal.

programme.title: Sou O Teu Homem
programme.desc: Para obter fundos de pesquisa para os seus estudos, uma cientista aceita uma oferta para participar numa experiência extraordinária: durante três semanas, ela deve viver com um robô humanoide, criado para fazê-la feliz.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: Joe
programme.desc: O atormentado Joe Ransom tenta esquecer o seu passado turbulento levando uma vida tranquila numa pequena cidade do Texas, onde conhece Gary, um rapaz de 15 anos, de quem acaba por tornar-se mentor e que acaba por defender de um pai violento e abusivo.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Barenboim: 50 years on stage
programme.desc: On August 19, 2000, the Teatro Colón was filled to the brim with spectators longing to hear Daniel Barenboim play the piano. Barenboim, who is currently best known as a conductor, started his career half a century ago as a child prodigy, playing his first piano recital at age 7. This concert celebrates the maestro's on-stage career.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Debussy, Chopin and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Sounds like Christmas
programme.desc: Set in the magnificent Cistercian Monastery Schulpforte near Naumburg, Germany, Sounds like Christmas combines festive music with the spontaneity and freshness of jazz. This Christmas program is the musical encounter between soprano Angelika Kirchschlager and jazz trumpeter Tomasz Stanko.

programme.title: Bruch - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 26
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance.

programme.title: Bach - Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2 No. 1 to 12
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Pianomania - Daniil Trifonov
programme.desc: Hannu Lintu conducts the Gulbenkian Orchestra in a Finnish flavoured concert program, since the concert features Cantus Articus, Op. 61 by Einojuhani Rautavaara, and Jean Sibelius’ Symphony No. 2. Furtermore, Daniil Trifonov (1991) is star soloist in Schumann’s Piano Concerto, Op. 54, which was premiered in 1841 by Clara Wieck, wife of the composer.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Bizet - L'Arlésienne Suite
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra (RNO) in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 with Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The concert opens with a selection of music by Georges Bizet based on Alphonse Daudet's play 'L'Arlésienne'. The music is compiled by Mikhail Pletnev. The first movement of Ravel's Piano Concerto No. 1 contains five distinctive themes, of which three are reminiscent of jazz.

programme.title: Dufay - Missa Ave regina caelorum
programme.desc: Why make use of a brilliant idea only once…? Guillaume Dufay upcycled his Marian antiphon Ave Regina Coeloruminto, a four-part mass, probably intended for the dedication of the cathedral of Cambrai. This dazzling piece of polyphony is a reminder of the extraordinary history of Kamerijk, which managed to maintain its position as an independent bastion in Burgundian territory.

programme.title: Vocal baroque works by Cavalli, Strozzi And Bembo
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
programme.desc: Musical critics from North America, Europe, and Russia praise Nalchik-born pianist Misha Fomin for his subtlety of touch and phrasing. He graduated cum laude from the Gnessin’s Russian Academy of Music, Moscow, where he studied with Lina Bulatova, a former student of professor Helen Gnessina and legendary Heinrich Neuhaus, and later continued his musical studies at the Hochschule für Musik “Franz Liszt” in Weimar.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 78
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No.

programme.title: Donizetti – L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: With Rolando Villazón directing and playing the title role, the world rushed for tickets to the Baden-Baden 2012 Pentecost-holiday opera. Following his directorial debut in 2011 (Werther, Lyon) the Mexican tenor went a step further, staging Gaetano Donizetti’s L’elisir d’amore and directing himself in the role of Nemorino.

programme.title: Rimsky-Korsakov - The Tale of Tsar Saltan Suite
programme.desc: In this exquisite 2016 concert from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall, the Russian National Orchestra and star-pianist Boris Berezovsky are led by conductor Mikhail Pletnev in a performance of magnificent works by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. Winner of the 1990 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow, Berezovsky interprets the works of Rimsky-Korsakov with a virtuosic power.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Trio élégiaque No. 1
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself.

programme.title: Bach - St. John Passion
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the marvelous Berliner Philharmoniker and performs Johann Sebastian Bach's splendid St. John Passion. The solo voice parts are sung by the renowned soloists Juliane Banse, Michael Chance, Ian Bostridge, Rainer Trost and Thomas Quasthoff. Also joining is the famous RIAS Kammerchor. Bach composed his passion, based on the Gospel of John, during his first year as director of church music in Leipzig.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Dvorák – Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In this documentary, Antonín Dvorák’s popular ‘Symphony No.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Hunting Brass
programme.desc: The German Brass is one of the most original and distinctive brass ensembles in the world. This group of talented musicians performs classical arrangements, dance versions of standards, and popular tunes that reflect an exceptional musical spirit.

programme.title: De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Francesco Durante Missa per I Morti
programme.desc: In the impressive Jacobikerk, artist in residence Marco Mencoboni will make Francesco Durante’s magnificent Requiem shimmer, with orchestra, soloists, two choirs, and a pair of French horns in the main role. With the breathtaking vocal control of soprano Valentina Mastrangelo – rising star of bel canto – this concert will be a highlight of the Festival.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Rachmaninov And Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know 'The Four Seasons of Vivaldi', it is one of the 'hits' of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco And Fellini
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the Giuseppe Nicolini Conservatory of Piacenza and the Giuseppe Verdi of Milan as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme.” On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. “Echoes of San Marco” is a tribute to the Venetian Renaissance composer Giovanni Gabrieli (1555-1612).

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27. After the disastrous premiere of the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in 1897, Rachmaninoff seriously doubted his ability as a symphonist. Almost a decade later, in October 1906, he started composing his Symphony No. 2. Months of revisions followed.

programme.title: Pedal Piano Concert - Schumann, Liszt a. o.
programme.desc: The pedal piano was a very popular instrument in the nineteenth century. Several composers, including Franz Liszt, Charles Gounod, and Camille Saint-Saëns, adapted old pieces or wrote new ones for this piano. Roberto Prosseda is one of the rare pianists performing on this instrument today.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: The spirits of Mozart
programme.desc: A crossover experience inspired by the music of Mozart: the surprising and original Spirits of Mozart. In this crossover concert, outstanding personalities from the fields of pop, jazz and classical music interpret Mozart`s compositions in their personal musical languages for a broad public of the 21st century. These performances show that the impact of Mozart`s music reaches far beyond the boundaries of classical music.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff: Piano Concerto No. 3,Op 30
programme.desc: The legendary pianist Vladimir Horowitz (1903-1989) won his first praise on his interpretation of Rachmaninoff's Third Piano Concerto from the composer himself. When Rachmaninoff heard the young Kiev-born pianist play his work shortly after Horowitz's arrival in New York in 1928, he exclaimed: 'He swallowed it whole.' Fifty years later, on September 24, 1978, Horowitz electrified his audience once again with this monumental work.

programme.title: Ultraje: Traje De Romaria - Vouga
programme.desc: “Ultraje” é uma viagem vibrante pelo coração da identidade portuguesa. Em cada episódio, percorremos o país para descobrir os trajes típicos que contam histórias de outras gerações, mergulhando nas tradições, costumes e festas que lhes dão vida. Mais do que roupa, são símbolos de orgulho, resistência e pertença — preservados por homens e mulheres que mantêm viva a memória coletiva.

programme.title: A Letra: Marco Rodrigues - 'Mãe'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas no significado das letras e no processo criativo por trás das canções. Marco Rodrigues quase não consegue cantar 'Mãe', a canção que Marisa Liz lhe ofereceu depois da sua mãe partir. Judite era adorada pelos amigos e colegas, e todos a quiseram homenagear.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T14 - Ep. 13

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T14 - Ep. 15

programme.title: Construções Ao Limite T6 - Ep. 4

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 69
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 16

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 73
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: Rebirth: Richard Lemz
programme.desc: Amsterdam, February 6th, 2018 - The short documentary Rebirth in The Amsterdam Red Light District illustrates how brutal Richard Lems' life as an addict was and his struggle to unshackle himself from the shame. Filled with fierce, freighting, and sad moments, Richard relives his stabbing, stay in jail, drug test, and drug use.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: MotorMusic: Hamster Axis of the one-click Panther
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter performed with his quartet at the North Sea Jazz festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Bixiga 70 - BIRD 2019
programme.desc: Stemming from Brazil's São Paulo, Bixiga 70 is an exciting brass and percussion-based instrumental dance ensemble that combines jazz, funk, and Afro-Brazilian music, incorporating elements from dub, reggae, electronics, cumbia, carimbo, Ethio-jazz, and samba. The name Bixiga 70 is taken from a vibrant neighbourhood in downtown São Paulo.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Pixel
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Philippe Lemm Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Christine Kamau
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: SummerJazz Leiden
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: The last chieftain
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Lorena's Tango
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Music Machine: Hammond And Steel
programme.desc: Drummer, percussionist, and bandleader Lucas van Merwijk stands for ardent, exotic swing. He has been at the forefront of the European jazz, Latin, and percussion scenes for more than 25 years. He has been playing Cuban music for many years, usually in large ensembles such as ‘Nueva Manteca’ and his 20-piece ‘Cubop City Big Band’.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard And The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone.

programme.title: Since You're Gone
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Morenika
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: TorTube: Tingvall Trio - Vägen
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: That Old Feeling
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Keith Jarrett - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind And Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Tokyo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet.

programme.title: New Cool Collective Big Band at the Oosterpoort
programme.desc: New Cool Collective have been happily grooving on 24 years of fame thanks to their unique mix of jazz, dance, latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo. As pioneers in the Dutch jazz scene NCC has received many awards and the band have toured the great expanses of Europe, Asia and North America.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Swing Dealers
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music.

programme.title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn, Free Your Mind
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Tambours de Brazzas
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Wolfert Brederode
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 35
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features light heavyweights Andre 'S.O.G.' Ward (25-0, 13 KOs) vs. Chad Dawson (31-1, 17 KOs) in a championship contest from the Oracle Arena in Oakland, California, USA, on September 8, 2012. A paid attendance of 7,611 brought in a gate of $706,469 and 1.

programme.title: FS WCK T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Experience the intensity of World Championship Kickboxing with the WCK Muay Thai Rules series, bringing elite international fighters into the spotlight for non-stop action. From explosive knockouts and technical battles to the electrifying atmosphere that has made Muay Thai one of the fastest-growing combat sports in the world, every bout delivers the excitement of world-class kickboxing.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: The main event in this episode sees Saul (Canelo) Alvarez making his first defense of the WBC light middleweight title, taking on challenger Ryan Rhodes. The bout ends in the final round after a series of unanswered blows. Also on the card, action from former light heavyweight champ Adonis Stevenson.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T29 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 2, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Terunofuji, Meisei, Kiribayama and Mitakeumi.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: American Ninja Warrior travels to Las Vegas, Nevada where the top finishers from the regional finals tackle the ultimate challenge - a four stage course modeled after 'Mount Midoriyama' in Japan, with new obstacles Coin Flip and Triple Swing.

programme.title: FS MMA T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! It's a quick knockout inthe main event as Nick Thompson slugs it out against Dustin Denes in Costa Rica.

The fight took place at the Home Depot Center in Carson, California, USA, on May 8, 2010.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: This episode features a bout between boxing legends Manny Pacquiao and Oscar De La Hoya, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a light heavyweight championship contest featuring Bernard Hopkins and Jean Pascal meeting for a second time. Their original contest, just five months earlier, resulted in a controversial draw, and the WBC ordered a rematch. Also on the card, action from young heavyweight stud Deontay Wilder.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T29 - Ep. 3

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: XMA T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the martial art of breaking and how the techniques are fine-tuned with technology.

programme.title: Fantástico - Ep. 2750
programme.desc: Programa em forma de revista eletrônica, o Show da Vida mistura jornalismo, denúncia, esporte, humor, dramaturgia, documentário, música e ciência.

programme.title: Altas Horas - Ep. 1270
programme.desc: Serginho Groisman promove, semanalmente, debates sobre temas relevantes com a participação da plateia, artistas e personalidades de diferentes áreas.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 151
programme.desc: Ferette nega que tenha mandado matar o pai de Paulinho. Leonardo tem esperança em reatar com Viviane. Arminda propõe fugir com Joaquim, em troca do dinheiro que estava nas Três Graças. Viviane volta a trabalhar na farmácia da Chacrinha. Raul pede trabalho para Rogério e Gerluce. Ferette deixa claro a Arminda que está determinado a acabar com Gerluce.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 152
programme.desc: Josefa fica cismada quando Gisleyne e Claudia encontram a aliança de Célio na mansão. Raul deixa Gerluce, Rogério e Zenilda intrigados quando diz que Edilberto estava junto de Samira nas negociações sobre o bebê. Herculano repreende Lena por manter contato com Joélly. Paulinho anuncia à família de Gerluce que Lena pode estar envolvida no esquema de tráfico de crianças.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 153
programme.desc: Paulinho avisa que vai continuar analisando as mensagens do celular de Edilberto, e afirma a Joélly que acredita que Lena saiba o que aconteceu com a filha da jovem. Lena diz a Samira que pensa em voltar para o Brasil. Gerluce repreende Joélly. Zenilda desconfia de que Arminda possa ter a ver com o sumiço de Célio. Consuelo e Misael se beijam.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 154
programme.desc: Consuelo deixa claro a Misael sua intenção de ficar com ele. Gisleyne deixa Alaíde e Rivaldo intrigados ao devolver a aliança de Célio. Joaquim sai da prisão e é avisado por Zenilda que aguardará julgamento em liberdade. Rogério entrega a aliança de Célio ao delegado Jairo e informa que pai de Alaíde desapareceu depois que esteve com Arminda. Paulinho confronta Arminda sobre o paradeiro de Célio.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 155
programme.desc: Helga assume que matou Célio, e Paulinho desconfia. Ferette afirma a Arminda que sabe que Helga assumiu o assassinato no lugar dela. Leonardo procura Ferette para dizer que não é mais seu filho. Ferette tenta atropelar Viviane, mas Leonardo percebe a tempo e empurra a farmacêutica, sendo atingido pelo veículo do pai.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 156
programme.desc: Ferette entra em pânico ao constatar que atingiu Leonardo. Viviane acusa Ferette de assassino. Zenilda fica apavorada ao saber por Rogério que Ferette atropelou Leonardo. Lorena pede desculpas a Juquinha por ter cobrado da namorada a informação sobre a prisão de Leonardo. Leonardo fica sabendo por Zenilda que o pai tentou matar Viviane. Viviane enfrenta Ferette no hospital.

programme.title: Lady Night - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Humberto Martins e Marcos Pasquim, ícones do peito peludo e virilidade sem camisa em toda novela, dessa vez com camisa e intimidados por uma mulher de 1,50m.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Irene descobre que Paulo Soares recebeu um telefonema antes de morrer. Marcelo fica nervoso quando não encontra a pasta no cofre. Filomena pressiona Marcelo para se livrar de Ana.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 54
programme.desc: Dalila se casa com Roberval. Ofélia sofre para chegar no casamento. Cristina convida Guto para o casamento para irritar Rafael. Vera hospeda Alexandra na sua casa e recebe ameaças.

programme.title: Malhação - Sonhos T22 - Ep. 263
programme.desc: Lobão sabota Gael. Gael abre os olhos de Duca em relação a Nat. Karina aprova vídeo clipe. Lucrécia discute com Ed. René fica empolgado com novo romance. Nat socorre Dandara.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 43
programme.desc: Ludmila conforta Ema, que sofre com a vida mais simples. Camilo descobre que Julieta confiscou seus bens. Julieta ameaça Xavier, que decide aceitar a proposta de se unir a Susana. Mariana visita Cecília. Ema encontra Lídia nos corredores do hotel em que está hospedada em São Paulo.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 132
programme.desc: Ronei aceita fazer a gravação da música de Agrado e João Raul usando estúdios diferentes para os dois. Eva, Cinara e Esteban comemoram a presidência de Zilá no Grupo Amaral. João Raul sofre ao pensar em quando conheceu Agrado. Irene confronta Walmir sobre o dinheiro furtado de sua loja. Agrado afirma que está disposta a deixar Bom Retorno com Leandro.

programme.title: Conversa Com Bial - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Uma conversa não é feita apenas de assuntos. Saber falar, ter o que dizer, ouvir e escutar são igualmente importantes para a construção de um diálogo.

programme.title: Rainha da Sucata - Ep. 139
programme.desc: Maria do Carmo fica balançada com a proposta de Armênia. Sérgio ofende Neiva e apanha de Saldanha. Armênia decide cortar os gastos na empresa. Laurinha recebe uma carta anônima.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 102
programme.desc: Cora, Maria Marta e Comendador vão atrás de Lorraine em Santa Teresa. Um grande protesto lota as ruas do bairro. Cláudio vai atrás de Leonardo e o encontra ferido.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 90
programme.desc: Gemma procura Bete para se unir. Agostina flagra Berilo e Jéssica juntos. Antero lembra que Gemma é a noiva que o abandonou na Itália. Saulo demite Mauro. Totó descobre que Clara roubou Bete.

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Eugênia hesita em usar o vestido feito por Lúcia/Alika. Jendal anuncia a data de casamento de Kênia e Mr. Jones. Kênia firma seu acordo financeiro com Mr. Campbell. Virgínia e as demais candidatas se surpreendem quando Eugênia surge com o vestido feito por Lúcia/Alika. Viriato aconselha Salma a dar uma chance para o amor de Fuad. Eugênia vence o concurso, e Lúcia/Alika comemora com Tonho.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Marcelo pede mais tempo a Filomena para convencer Ana a vender sua parte nos restaurantes. Júlia fala ao traficante sobre a criação de creche e escola na favela.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 55
programme.desc: Rafael fica furioso ao encontrar Serena dançando com Guto, Hélio tenta amenizar a situação e conta a verdade para o empresário. Ofélia incomoda todos na pensão.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 44
programme.desc: Ema diz a Lídia que todos estão em São Paulo à sua procura. Uirapuru se desespera e se apressa em deixar o hotel com Lídia. Elisabeta incentiva Jane a conversar com Camilo sobre o futuro dos dois. Rômulo revela para Cecília a história sobre a morte de Josephine, e Fani ouve. Camilo declara seu amor por Jane e decide viver no cortiço. Darcy e Elisabeta se beijam. Cecília se apavora com uma visão.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 133
programme.desc: Adilson ameaça Walmir. Walmir descobre segredo de Adilson. João Raul e Agrado se emocionam ao ouvir a versão final de sua música juntos. Leandro e Agrado terminam seu relacionamento. Adilson confessa seu segredo à população de Bom Retorno. Walmir garante a Irene que conseguirá retomar o controle de sua vida. João Raul acompanha Walmir em sua primeira reunião no grupo de reabilitação.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 157
programme.desc: Rogério ajuda Viviane a entrar no quarto de Leonardo. Leonardo e Viviane declaram amor mútuo. programme.title: Fatal Destination T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: As férias primaveris de uma adolescente em Myrtle Beach transformam-se num pesadelo após desaparecer numa noite. A busca de uma década conta segredos.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Quando Mike Bernos é encontrado morto a tiro numa poltrona, o seu filho adotivo, Daniel Blan, é condenado. Porém, a esposa de Daniel afirma que ele é inocente.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Steven Beard, um executivo da televisão reformado, é morto a tiro na sua casa, mas a esposa, Celeste, não apertou o gatilho. Resta saber porque razão foi presa.

programme.title: Murder In The Heartland T6 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Beth Kutz, mãe de dois filhos, desaparece em Poynette, Wisconsin, e os investigadores descobrem algumas verdades incómodas nesta adorada família.

programme.title: Murder In The Heartland T6 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Um pai desaparece e a pequena cidade de Challis, Idaho, faz mexericos, deixando os investigadores a tentar decifrar o que é facto e o que é ficção.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Bobby e Patricia vivem felizes com as suas três filhas. Mas quando uma noite Bobby não regressa a casa, a sua esposa participa o seu desaparecimento à Polícia.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O corpo decapitado de Beverly McGowan dá à costa nas margens pantanosas dos Everglades. Os investigadores dão caça a um suspeito implacável durante 12 anos.

programme.title: Fatal Destination T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: As férias primaveris de uma adolescente em Myrtle Beach transformam-se num pesadelo após desaparecer numa noite. A busca de uma década conta segredos.

programme.title: Fatal Destination T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Uma viagem de luxo nas Bahamas torna-se aterradora ao surgir um barco à deriva, com sangue, tripulação desaparecida e segredos submersos.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Duas mulheres jovens desaparecem depois de se aventurarem a sair sozinhas à noite. Será que as pistas que vêm da cadeia ajudam a resolver o mistério deste desaparecimento?.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Os sonhos de um jovem atleta promissor chegam ao fim quando se descobre que foi morto a tiro. A família inicia uma luta implacável em busca de justiça.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows Of Death T3 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Em 2008, um homem encontrou a sua mulher assassinada em casa. Com poucas pistas no caso, os investigadores rapidamente descobrem que nem tudo é o que parece na sua vida perfeita.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: My Child The Killer T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um pai descobre que o filho cometeu três homicídios e toma a decisão custosa de o denunciar, o que destrói a relação entre ambos para sempre.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T4 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Quando Alvin 'Bud' Brown foi preso, afirmou que era como Hannibal Lecter. Para a sua esposa ele era perfeito. Mas ela muda de opinião ao saber a verdade sobre ele.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T4 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Sinais suspeitos levam a revelações chocantes nestes relatos verídicos de pessoas que descobrem que viviam com um assassino. Veja até que ponto foram envolvidas pelo mal.

programme.title: Death In The Bayou: The Jennings 8 T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Entre 2005 e 2009, os corpos de oito jovens mulheres são encontrados em Jennings, no Louisiana. Os casos permanecem em aberto, até que é feita uma prisão surpreendente.

programme.title: The Real Story with Maria Elena Salinas T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Duas jovens morrem em circunstância misteriosas, com dois anos de diferença. Estes crimes parecem não ter relação, mas são fruto da depravação de um assassino calculista.

programme.title: The Lake Erie Murders T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Quando um corpo contendo partes de um corpo, as buscas por Holly Jones, de 10 anos, transformam-se numa investigação de homicídio.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Edith revolta-se contra os seus pais conservadores, casando com o líder de um bando de motoqueiros. Porém, a situação acaba em tragédia e ela é encontrada morta.

programme.title: Lethally Blonde T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Em 1995, em Hermosa Beach, Linda Sobek é uma modelo em ascensão, mas uma sessão fotográfica com um fotógrafo misterioso acaba em tragédia.

programme.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: April enche o TikTok com positividade, mas quando se abre sobre saúde mental e problemas no casamento, a mãe Jamie descobre segredos chocantes.

programme.title: The Lake Erie Murders T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Quando um corpo contendo partes de um corpo, as buscas por Holly Jones, de 10 anos, transformam-se numa investigação de homicídio.

programme.title: Espaço Kanuca
programme.desc: Um espaço dedicado às músicas e promos especiais da Kanuca TV.

programme.title: Decobrindo a Bíblia
programme.desc: Será que conheces bem a Bíblia? Agora é a tua chance de testar o teu conhecimento e divertires-te como nunca! Com categorias emocionantes e perguntas desafiadoras, cada episódio é uma nova oportunidade de aprender e acertar. Reune a tua família e os teus amigos, e participa no descobrindo a bíblia.

programme.title: Superbook
programme.desc: Conheça Chris e joy, 2 crianças que estão sempre prontas para viver as aventuras do passado com o Superbook. Uma série com muitos ensinamentos bíblicos que vai permitir conhecer a Deus , despertar a curiosidade e fortalecer a fé.

programme.title: Contos das Estrelinhas do Bem
programme.desc: 'Contos das Estrelinhas' é uma série infantil produzida pela KanucaTV, voltada para o público mais jovem. A série apresenta uma série de histórias lúdicas e encantadoras que têm como objetivo ensinar valores importantes para as crianças de maneira divertida e envolvente.

programme.title: Chocolix
programme.desc: Os Chocolix são uma família de chocolates de diversas cores que vivem no esplêndido Reino da Chocolândia. Dona Branca, Don Cacau e seus filhos Chocomark e Chocholyne embarcam em grandes aventuras.

programme.title: Família Dumbo
programme.desc: A Família Dumbo chega à Kanuca TV trazendo o retrato divertido e emocionante de uma família típica de Benguela, onde cada episódio transforma desafios do dia-a-dia em histórias cheias de humor, valores e identidade angolana. Entre confusões, gargalhadas e lições inesperadas, a Família Dumbo mostra que em cada casa angolana existe uma história que merece ser contada.

programme.title: Sol em Dó Ré Mi
programme.desc: Sol é uma menina de 6 anos que toca uma melodia secreta num piano do sótão e consegue abrir um portal para Dó Ré Mi.

programme.title: Gemini8
programme.desc: Gemini 8 é uma série animada que narra as aventuras de Marco, um garoto terrestre que, ao ser puxado por uma pipa através de um portal, é transportado para o distante planeta Gemini 8. Apresenta uma mistura de aventura e ficção científica, explorando temas como amizade, exploração e o desconhecido.
